test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 16 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Six friends C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting in a row facing north. F is 2ⁿd to the left of E, who is 2ⁿd to the left of G. D is 2ⁿd to the right of H, who is an immediate neighbour of E and G. Where is C seated?
solution:
Given:

Step 1): Six friends C, D, E, F, G, and H are sitting in a row facing north.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f577bbf30897413cb32c713d8ac0cfb0301fe69d17723a6d04e429fe84bb196c.png] 

Step 2): (a) F is 2nd to the left of E

(b) E is 2nd to the left of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/23a6cd51abc470417a914f811a03d9d455bfbda8a366d09bed080883b838e725.png] 

OR, 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9efceaa3763f2761877745917585c8b6915733905532ec83bfd49b7557550874.png] 

Step 3): (a) D is 2nd to the right of H

(b) H is an immediate neighbour of E and G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c5de4583901c19225d612437df8a4c8db52330fac64a70106aa9f48a78720cec.png] 

According to the arrangement, C is sitting between E & F.

Hence, the correct answer is** option 2).**
